jobs.title: Director of Agricultural Development
jobs.description_text: Rainmaker is pioneering a modern precipitation enhancement cloud seeding system to solve water scarcity. We develop and incorporate radar validation, weather-resistant UAS, and numerical weather modeling to make water abundant. As Rainmaker’s Director of Agricultural Development, you will own our engagement with the U.S. Department of Agriculture and the agricultural community in Washington. You will build the programs, partnerships, and funding pathways that connect precipitation enhancement to the conservation and water supply needs of American producers, and you will own the Congressional relationships and coalition presence that make the work durable. This position is based in Washington, DC. Significant stock options with high potential upside as an early-stage company 401(k) with employer matching Full health coverage (medical, dental, and vision insurance) Relocation assistance provided (if applicable) Unlimited PTO Paid parental leave for both parents

jobs.description_text: Rainmaker is pioneering a modern precipitation enhancement cloud seeding system to solve water scarcity. We develop and incorporate radar validation, weather-resistant UAS, and numerical weather modeling to make water abundant. You will own our engagement with the Department of State by building the programs, partnerships, and funding pathways that pair American precipitation enhancement technology with the water security needs of partner nations. Water scarcity is a geopolitical problem before it is a technical one. Rainmaker’s goal is to make American cloud seeding the technology partner nations turn to, and this role is how we get there in Washington. This position is based in Washington, DC and works as an embedded member of the International Team. Data is at the heart of Lyft’s products and decision-making. You will leverage data and rigorous, analytical thinking to shape our products and make business decisions. The Airports team, within the Driver organization, focuses on the airport marketplace and the unique products designed for this use case. jobs.title: Senior Business Development Manager - Dissemination & Distribution
jobs.description_text: If you're a driven sales professional with deep roots in the asset management sector and a passion for connecting clients to the data solutions they depend on, this is a rare opportunity to own and shape a high-growth territory across DACH and Central Europe. As Senior Business Development Manager, you'll take the lead on one of FE fundinfo's most strategically important regions, bringing our Dissemination & Distribution solutions to asset managers, fund promoters, platforms and data vendors across Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Central Europe. This is a role where your market knowledge, client relationships and commercial instincts will directly influence product direction, go-to-market strategy, and the growth of a business that sits at the heart of the fund distribution ecosystem. You'll work alongside talented colleagues across sales, product and client success, with the backing of a dedicated BDR team and marketing function. Your key responsibilities as a Senior Business Development Manager will include: Owning and executing the sales strategy for our Dissemination and Distribution solutions across asset managers and fund promoters in Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Central Europe. Driving pipeline growth and bookings through programmatic execution of the DACH and Central Europe go-to-market plan, including cross-sell and new name sales plays. Positioning FE fundinfo's Dissemination solutions to help clients distribute fund data, factsheets and regulatory documents
